content: AI動画は長尺になるほどキャラクターや背景が崩れやすいので、Seedance 2.5で30秒の連続ショットを作るときは「キャラクターの姿・主要な動き（例：スケートボード）・空間（例：美術館）」を一貫して維持することを目標にして生成する
tips: AI動画は長尺になるほどキャラクターや背景が崩れやすいので、Seedance 2.5で30秒の連続ショットを作るときは「キャラクターの姿・主要な動き（例：スケートボード）・空間（例：美術館）」を一貫して維持することを目標にして生成する

en.content:
AI videos tend to break down in terms of characters and backgrounds the longer they run, so when creating a 30-second continuous shot with Seedance 2.5, the goal is to generate it while consistently maintaining the character’s appearance, the main action (e.g., skateboarding), and the space (e.g., a museum).

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
#capcutseedance25 #capcutcpp
Seedance 2.5 is now available in CapCut❣️
In AI videos, the longer they get, the more likely the characters and backgrounds are to fall apart.
So I tried using Seedance 2.5 to create a 30-second continuous shot while preserving Imaginary Kamichan’s appearance, the skateboard movement, and the museum setting✨

Please pay attention to how, even as the paint shapes keep changing one after another, everything remains connected as a single world🎨
Created using CapCut’s AI feature “Seedance 2.5”٩( ᐛ )و
